name: sous-chefox
description: A Firefox extension for unit conversions and calculations in recipes.

scripts.prebuild: node -e "if (+process.versions.node.split('.')[0] < 22) { console.error('Node 22+ required (see .nvmrc): run nvm use'); process.exit(1) }"
scripts.build: vite build && vite build --mode popup && vite build --mode background
